result.title: RATED: Reliability-Aware AI Agent Tool Retrieval via Execution Dynamics
result.summary: As AI agents increasingly rely on external tools, accurate retrieval is essential for reliable behavior. Existing methods optimize semantic relevance but largely ignore tool availability during execution. To address this gap, we propose RATED (Reliability-Aware Tool Retrieval via Execution Dynamics), a retrieval framework that combines robust semantic matching with dynamic reliability adaptation. RATED employs a frozen dual-encoder with contrastive fine-tuning for semantic matching, and a lightweight contextual bandit module that re-ranks candidates based on real-time execution feedback. This design enables rapid adaptation to runtime tool failures without expensive model retraining. We introduce EcoAgent, a benchmark of 5,172 real-world tools and over 210,000 query-tool pairs for offline retrieval and dynamic reliability evaluation. Experimental results demonstrate that RATED achieves a 52.2% relative MRR improvement over the ToolLLM API retriever on real-world queries, and reduces fault selection rate from 86.2% to 2.9% under severe API outage scenarios with a 30% failure rate, while incurring negligible latency overhead of less than 1 ms over encode-only inference. The code and dataset are available at https://github.com/Elliotes/EcoAgent.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 RATED 工具检索框架：用冻结双编码器做语义匹配，再用轻量 contextual bandit 依据运行时执行反馈对候选重排，并发布含 5172 个工具、21 万余 query-tool 对的 EcoAgent 基准。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「用执行反馈在线重排、无需重训模型即适应工具失效」的机制，可能为 LVR 中依据证据可靠性动态选择是否继续 LOOK/何时 STOP 提供方法线索，能否迁移到视觉证据筛选可供核查。
